name: G6 T3 W03 Part 2 - Build a story table
description: Build a story table. 2 words. Required: Flashcards and Fill in Blank. Read the Spark with the same name. Use this part in its Technology class.

words.definition: Information arranged in rows and columns.
words.example: The table puts club names beside their student counts.

words.definition: Facts and values that a computer can store and use.
words.example: The data shows that 12 students chose chess.
